class.name: BlueprintCanvas2D
class.brief_description: 2D scene node that renders a BlueprintResource floorplan.
class.description: Draws spaces, exterior/interior walls, and feature symbols from a bound [BlueprintResource] scaled by [member pixels_per_meter] and filtered by [member visible_layer_mask].

method.name: set_layer_visible
method.description: Enables or disables drawing of a specific [enum BlueprintResource.LayerIndex].

method.name: is_layer_visible
method.description: Returns whether the specified blueprint layer is currently visible.

members.member: Scale factor converting architectural meters to 2D canvas pixels.
Bitmask controlling which blueprint layers are drawn.
